sentences.text:
Mahesh Rajawat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 July,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:14174
 1 M
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Ashish Shroti
 On The 10th Of July, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 26495 of 2025
 Mahesh Rajawat
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Ajit Singh Bhadoria - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Rohit Mishra- Aag for the respondent/State.
 Order
The applicant has filed this second application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023/439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 18/12/2024 by Police Station-Mehgaon, District- Bhind (M.P.) in connection with Crime No. 83/2019 registered in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 406, 418 and 420 of IPC.
2. First bail application of the applicant was dismissed on merits vide order dated 25/3/2025 in M.Cr.C..No. 5007/2025.
3.Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the matter.
There is no recovery of agricultural produce from the applicant and since he was the driver of the truck, the truck was recovered from him.
He also submits that after rejection of his earlier bail application on 25/3/2025, more than three months period has expired.
Applicants is permanent resident of District Bhind and there is no possibility
NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:14174 2 MCRC-26495-2025 of his absconsion.
He also submits that applicant is in custody since 18/12/2024 and there is very bleak possibility of early conclusion of trial.
On these grounds, prayer for bail is made out.
4. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for dismissal of the application.

5. sentences.text: rejection of his earlier bail application, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court.

6. This Order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant :-
1.
The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;

2. The applicant will cooperate in the investigation/Trial, as the case may be;
3.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigation Officer, as the case may be.
A copy of this order be sent to the Court concerned for compliance.
